payload.summary: The full draft allocations scheme as residents saw it during the consultation, and the longest document in this archive. It sets out who could join the register, the five priority bands, how homes are advertised and bid for, and how to challenge a decision, including the exception that lets someone keep priority despite rent arrears “where a person is fleeing violence and has rent arrears”. Because the council later published the adopted version in the same form, this draft is what makes it possible to see which wording moved and which did not.
